follow-on: main() rewrites the SVG to strip trailing whitespace from every line, a change the goal does not imply and the commit message does not mention; it alters the committed SVG bytes and therefore the receipt's svg_sha256, and while it is harmless here (the file carries no xml:space attribute) it is unexplained scope a reader cannot attribute to any requirement.
